texto.muro: the calm, deep dark studio space on the left of the frame

escena: SCENE (cinematic, a real SIX-SECOND long-exposure photograph taken on a tripod in a busy dark film studio at night): Nexa, as in her reference, stands perfectly still and SHARP with her face at about 72 % of the frame width, framed from the waist up, wearing the Efeonce hoodie exactly as in its reference, both arms relaxed at her sides; her head stays almost frontal and her eyes turn toward the empty dark left of the frame, where the text will sit, with calm complicity; between the left edge of the frame and her body there is a wide band of empty darkness. Around her the whole production keeps moving during the six seconds: ONE crew member's soft translucent ghost passes just behind the camera-right side of her body at about 80 % of the frame width, ONE more at the right edge of the frame, and ONE far in the depth of the studio at about 66 %; a camera dolly left a long smear at the right edge; dozens of pieces carried on a rail behind her are long, bright, continuous horizontal streaks of cool white-azure light (#0375DB), racing across the whole right 40 % of the frame from her body to the right edge, dense like the light trails of a city at night. Every ghost, smear and streak lives entirely inside the right 40 % of the frame; nothing that moves is visible to the left of her body. The pieces streaking past are versions of the same campaign as the finished piece. Beside her, on the camera-right side of her body, at about 84 % of the frame width, on a slim matte black stand at chest height, ONE finished campaign piece on a small screen stays razor sharp and perfectly still; on it, ONE single tiny point glows vivid orange (#FF6500), the only accent in the frame; it lights nothing around it. Everything that moves is blurred; only she and the finished piece are sharp. The streaks never cross her face and never pass into the left half of the frame. LIGHT: the screen of the finished piece is the only key light, cool white, from the camera-right side at chest height; NO fill light, the far side of her face in shadow with the nose shadow legible; the streaks behind her only outline her hair and shoulders. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two and a half meters away at chest height, 85mm. Real long-exposure physics. Thin haze catches the streaks. No practical lamp is visible in the frame; no red LEDs. The LEFT 60 % of the frame is calm, deep dark studio space with only faint haze: no objects, no light shapes, no streaks, no pieces; everything lit lives in the right 40 %. Rich contrast, deep navy blacks, real sensor grain, genuine depth of field. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos of any other brand.
